$description: Contrast exceptions for Lockdown's theme (src/styles/lockdown-theme.css), measured by unicron 1.1's `unicron-contrast` (`pnpm contrast`, CI's desktop job). Each is a pair under its floor with Lockdown's Figma values, with why. The list must match the misses exactly: one that starts passing fails the run, so it cannot go stale. Started from unicron's playground copy (apps/playground/src/app-themes/lockdown.exceptions.json); the misses every theme shares (the critical and needs-you colours) are the core's own.
